5 AP +15% Incoming Damage Deferred
Killing Blow
Active: Leap forward, dealing spirit damage to the first enemy hero. If they are below the kill threshold, execute them instead. Finishing an enemy with Killing Blow lets you recast for 12s
Passive: Damaging enemies fills you with rage. While at full rage, Shiv gains increased damage and unlocks special properties on his other abilities.
Cooldown is increased by +30% if no hero is impacted.
Unlocking Shiv's Killing Blow ultimate also unlocks his unique rage mechanic. Rage is built by dealing damage to players, including any damage to Barriers. Shiv's rage meter has a max value of 10 which must be filled before becoming Enraged, granting the full rage bonuses. No bonuses are granted for a partial rage meter.
Rage will begin to decay after 12 seconds of not dealing any damage, at a rate of 0.25 per second (43 seconds total).
The amount of damage required to build a full bar (10 points) of rage varies based on the damage type (weapon, spirit, and light/heavy melee) and increases linearly with Shiv's bullet damage, spirit power, and melee damage, respectively.
The rate of increase is chosen so that improving Shiv's bullet damage, spirit power, or melee damage stats does not meaningfully change how much rage a single shot, melee, or ability cast generates.
(For the purpose of this calculation, percent increases to weapon damage from e.g. Glass Cannon count as increasing Shiv's base bullet and melee damage.)
The only way to increase how much rage is generated by a single shot/ability cast is to increase one's damage in ways other than improving spirit power or bullet damage. For example, headshots build rage 1.65x as fast as bodyshots because of their crit multiplier, while shots affected by damage falloff will build less. Bullet and spirit resistances (positive or negative) also affect rage generation.
Additionally, some items which grant conditional weapon damage or spirit power can increase how much rage is given per shot/ability cast. These items are
Spirit Items (improve rage generation for imbued ability)
Gun Items (improve rage generation while condition is met)
All other sources of conditional spirit power or weapon damage do not change how much rage is generated per shot/ability cast.

1 AP +6m Range +2m/s in Full Rage.
2 AP +16% Full Rage Bonus Damage -25s Cooldown
5 AP +10% Enemy Health Threshold
Source: https://deadlock.wiki/Shiv
